cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Leave empty for all three cities. Each city is read from its own official open-data portal.

keywords.title: Keywords (permit type, work type or description)
keywords.description: A permit matches if any keyword appears, e.g. "solar", "roof", "ADU", "demolition", "pool". Leave empty for all permits.

permitTypeContains.title: Permit type contains
permitTypeContains.description: Text in the permit type or work type, e.g. "electrical", "plumbing", "new construction".

minValueUsd.title: Minimum project value (USD)
minValueUsd.description: Skips permits whose declared value is below this or missing. Declared values are what the applicant reported; some cities use placeholders like 1.

zipCodes.title: ZIP codes
zipCodes.description: 5-digit ZIP codes. New Orleans does not publish a ZIP, so those permits are excluded when this is set.

lookbackDays.title: Days back (issue date)
lookbackDays.description: Portals publish with a lag of about 1 to 3 days. With "only new" on and a daily schedule, a 7-day window repeats nothing and catches every permit the city publishes within 7 days of its issue date.

onlyNew.title: Only permits not output before (for schedules)
onlyNew.description: Remembered per filter set in a named key-value store. Turn off to get the whole window every time.

includeDescription.title: Include the work description
includeDescription.description: Free text from the permit, shortened to 800 characters. E-mail addresses and phone numbers typed into it are replaced by a marker.

includeContractorCompany.title: Include the contractor company name
includeContractorCompany.description: Austin and New Orleans only. A name is output only if it contains a business word (LLC, Inc, Roofing, ...); other names are dropped. This is a heuristic: a sole trader whose trade name has such a word can pass.

maxItems.title: Max permits per run
maxItems.description: You are charged per permit stored (plus Apify's small per-run start fee), so this caps the cost of a run. Permits cut by the limit stay new for the next run while they are still inside the window.

socrataAppToken.title: Socrata app token (optional)
socrataAppToken.description: Not needed. If the portals throttle you at high volume, a free token from the portal raises the limit.

stateStoreName.title: State store name (advanced)
stateStoreName.description: Leave empty to use the default.
